text:
anya: Quick design review — small follow-ups on the span context flyout from yesterday's mock. thoughts?

sam: looked through the figma. main UX ask: make the correlation-id pill keyboard-focusable and expose its copy action via Enter. currently it's only a click target.

maria: agree. also contrast on the pill is a little low on 14px text at 100% zoom. WCAG AA fail on a few monitors. can we bump bg to #1f2937 or change text to #ffffff?

jordan: +1 to both. for keyboard: propose role=\"button\" + aria-label=\"Copy correlation id\" and visible focus outline.

kevin: fine, but let's avoid extra visual noise — maybe use a 2px dashed focus ring only when keyboard-focused (use :focus-visible).

anya: good call. sam, do we want a tooltip on hover that also appears on focus? accessibility team recommended it for discoverability.

sam: tooltip ok as long as it doesn't trap keyboard flow. also we should announce via aria-live when copy succeeds: \"Correlation ID copied to clipboard\".

maria: copy text needs to be concise: current \"ID copied\" feels ambiguous. prefer the full phrase Sam suggested.

jordan: also noticed export action in the flyout is labeled \"Download\" — maybe confusing with whole-trace download. Can we change to \"Export span (.json)\" and add a small helper text \"includes full stack and metadata\" ?

kevin: prefer shorter copy: \"Export span (JSON)\" — consistent with other export verbs. helper text could be hidden visually but available to screen readers if space is tight.

anya: on layout — the stacktrace preview is cramped. propose toggling a monospace preview with a \"Show more\" to expand rather than truncating inline. reduces visual density.

maria: +1. Also, ensure code block uses aria-label=\"Stacktrace preview\" and that line wrapping is controlled so screen readers don't get weird.

sam: small CSS snippet for focus outline I tested: 

```css
.corr-pill:focus-visible {
  outline: 3px solid #2563EB;
  outline-offset: 2px;
}
```

kevin: looks good; can we add a prefers-reduced-motion media query for the hover tooltip? some customers need it.

anya: thanks. action items: 
1) @sam to update prototype: pill role + focus styles + tooltip + aria-live copy confirmation.
2) @maria to propose color tokens for pill bg/text with contrast checks.
3) @jordan to add Export span copy change and guidance for helper text visibility.
4) @kevin to add reduced-motion and :focus-visible CSS and ensure no regressions.

sam: putting a quick figma link with notes: https://www.figma.com/file/abc123/span-flyout — comments on frame.

maria: I'll run contrast checks and drop swatches into the figma comments.

jordan: I'll update the copy in the content spec and post a diff.

design-bot: Reminder: Please add required accessibility checklist tags to the PR description (a11y: color-contrast, keyboard-nav, aria-labels).

anya: Perfect. If nobody objects, I'll merge these small tweaks into the next sprint's design tasks. :thumbsup:
